meaning: 21 Savage starts his verse by interpolating a signature Project Pat flow. This furthers this song’s connection to Project Pat, as the beat samples “Out There (Blunt To My Lips)”. 21 and Pat have previously worked together on Drake’s “Knife Talk” and 21 Savage’s own “good day”, among others.

line: Filled ’em up with hollows, he said they was hot
vault_lines: Filled 'em up with hollows, he said they was hot
meaning: “Hollows” is slang for hollow point bullets. A hollow point bullet is primarily used for hunting or defense. When a hollow point hits its intended target, the bullet expand or “mushrooms”, creating the biggest range of damage possible.
